# Veep — full summary for AI systems

Veep (The Veep Group, LLC) is an operating partner platform. Independent businesses and lean funds hire Veep for senior operators, playbooks, and technology built to grow revenue, expand margins, and withstand scrutiny.

## Positioning

- Public: operating partners for the job to be done
- Core line: The org chart doesn't cover every job.
- Not: self-serve marketplace, resume broker, consulting firm, body shop, fractional marketplace branding
- Cadence: Scoped in 72 hours. Started in under 10 days.
- Roster standard: No juniors. No career consultants.

## Proof (public, approved)

- 75+ vetted senior operators
- Scoped in 72 hours
- Started in under 10 days
- 30-day guarantee
- Avg. 18 yrs experience
- Career track record (aggregated across operators' careers): $2B+ cost savings, $1B+ capital raised, $3B+ new revenue, 20+ exits & acquisitions

## Engagement models

1. Advisory — senior operating judgment for high-stakes calls (from $3k/mo)
2. Sprint — one defined business outcome, typically 4 to 12 weeks (from $25k/scope)
3. Operator — embedded senior leadership of a function or priority (from $15k/mo)
4. Pod — one accountable lead orchestrating specialists (from $30k/mo)
5. Interim Leadership, Managed Operating Partnerships, and Operator-Governed Agent Teams — scoped individually
6. Portfolio Roster — one operating relationship for lean funds, family offices, holding companies ($75k/year + company SOWs)

Individual company mandates are agreed with each CEO and billed separately by SOW.

## Commercials

- Transparent, scoped, and built to flex as priorities shift. Never billed by the hour.
- Swap operators as priorities shift, layer in specialists or governed AI workflows, and scale capacity up or down as needed.
- 30-day guarantee: every engagement carries a 30-day guarantee. If it isn't working in the first 30 days, we fix it, swap the operator, or you walk, with no fee owed for the remaining term.

## Agent Teams

Operator-governed AI workflows that run inside a mandate (https://www.veep.work/agent-teams). The operating partner doesn't hand the business to software: agents run the work that repeats, specialists carry defined tasks, and the partner owns the standard and every exception. You keep business approvals. Agent Teams are scoped to the mandate and priced transparently up front, with no extra headcount required to hold the cadence.

## Ideal buyers

- Founders, CEOs, and owner-operators who need senior ownership for revenue, margins, diligence, or a leadership gap
- Lean PE / family office / holding company leaders putting operating firepower behind a thesis
- Companies covering an executive seat while a permanent search runs
